{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Check for sentinel values in customer_age
print(f"Number of -1 values in customer_age: {df[df['customer_age'] == -1].shape[0]}")

# Check the revenue column: look for thousands separators
print(f"First 5 revenue values: {df['revenue'].head().tolist()}")

# Check for QA orders with revenue = 999999.99
qa_orders = df[df['revenue'] == '999999.99']
print(f"Number of QA orders (revenue = 999999.99): {qa_orders.shape[0]}")

# Check status column
print(f"Unique values in status: {df['status'].unique()}")

# Check channel and segment distributions
print(f"Channel distribution: {df['channel'].value_counts().to_dict()}")
print(f"Customer segment distribution: {df['customer_segment'].value_counts().to_dict()}")

# Print first few rows to confirm
print(df.head())"}
